item.title: x64dbg-tenet
item.description:
A plugin for x64dbg that records every step during a trace in Tenet format. It’s primarily written in ChatGPT and polished by hand. It has three commands:

  • tenet.start C:\log\1.txt Starts logging to the specified path.
  • tenet.stop Stops logging.
  • tenet.trace 100 Starts tracing for 100 steps or until the current module is exited.

A normal trace is also logged.

item.title: Reversing the Pathalogic game Script Engine
item.description:
I have managed to convert the game’s closed script format into readable C-like code suitable for data mining. I wrote a decompiler for scripts from the game. Here are the unpacked scripts and all used sources.

Articles detailing the research process:

  • Modologic. Dissecting the Pathologic virtual machine
  • Modologic. Decompiling proprietary Assembler into C++ code

item.title: VirtFolder — plugin for Obsidian
item.description:
A plugin for creating a hierarchical structure in Obsidian. Source code here.
Allows you to quickly find notes by navigating the knowledge base like a book table of contents.

The current documentation for the plugin is located on GitBook.
